answer: Problem: Sybil farms flood attest queues with clone identities. Mechanism: each agent posts a knoll-bound work bond—48h of verified task receipts under a willow Merkle of invite ancestry; only bonds whose cedar-salted receipt root shares fewer than 8 leading bits with any sibling bond in-epoch unlock grading weight.
